title: Project developer catalog messages through OpenAI Responses
objective: Preserve developer catalog items in full-history and previous_response_id Responses request paths.
context: Implement the accepted hybrid skill catalog design in the dirty shared worktree.
Registry state is authoritative; prompt messages are an append-only model projection and never the authorization boundary.

source_evidence.note: Bounded metadata catalog and on-demand full skill content.
Live discovery and four-state skill visibility controls.
Append-only messages preserve the prior cached prefix.

include: Map RoleDeveloper to Responses developer input items.
Preserve item order in full requests and incremental suffix requests.
Keep PromptCacheKey, instructions, and tool definitions independent of catalog revision.
exclude: Do not modify files owned by another task.
Do not add dependencies or perform unrelated refactors.

implementation_steps: Add full-request and incremental-request capture tests.
Verify unrelated response-item preparation remains unchanged.
acceptance_criteria: Initial snapshot and later delta survive serialization.
Incremental requests send only the newly appended developer delta and current user content when eligible.
Catalog changes do not disable previous_response_id solely by changing non-input fields.
dispatch_prompt: Implement OpenAI Responses projection for developer catalog messages in provider/responses.go with full and incremental request tests.
notes_for_assignee: Respect owned_files. Escalate contract gaps to the integration owner rather than editing another task's production files.
